content.title: When will your Social Security payment arrive in April 2026? See the schedule
content.text: April 1, 2026, 4:08 a.m. ETMost people who receive Social Security retirement benefits will see their monthly payments in April 2026 as usual — with checks and direct deposits distributed according to the Social Security Administration’s standard schedule.Here's more on payments, including the April payment for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients. While SSI and Social Security are separate programs, about half of SSI recipients also receive Social Security, which is why the distinction matters.Social Security payment dates for April 2026The Social Security Administration published the 2026 schedule for benefit payments:If you receive regular Social Security benefits (not SSI), your payment will arrive on one of the following dates, based on your birthdate and when you first began collecting benefits:Friday, April 3 - People who began receiving benefits before May 1997Wednesday, April 8 - Birthdates between the 1st and 10thWednesday, April 15 - Birthdates between the 11th and 20thWednesday, April 22 - Birthdates between the 21st and 31stWhat is SSI?Supplemental Security Income (SSI) provides financial support to individuals who are:Age 65 or older.Blind.Have a qualifying disability, and who also meet strict income and asset requirements.Adults must generally earn less than $2,019/month in wages to qualify. Many SSI recipients also receive Social Security benefits, but the two programs are funded separately.Will I receive a SSI payment in April 2026?Yes. For the first time this calendar year, the monthly SSI payment will land on its regular scheduled date. In April that is on Wednesday, April 1.On months when the first falls on a weekend or federal holiday, SSI payments are made on the preceding business day, according to standard SSA policy.SSI payment dates in 2026The remaining SSI payment dates for 2026 are as follows:Friday, May 1 - May paymentMonday, June 1 - June paymentWednesday, July 1 - July paymentFriday, July 31 - August paymentTuesday, Sept. 1 - September paymentThursday, Oct. 1 - October paymentFriday, Oct. 30 - November paymentTuesday, Dec. 1 - December paymentThursday, Dec. 31 - January 2027 paymentIncludes reporting by the USA Today network
